get_topdown_map_from_sim: get a top-down occupancy map from a HabitatSim simulator instance with configurable resolution and border drawing
draw_agent: draw a rotated and resized agent sprite onto an image at specified coordinates with a given rotation angle
pointnav_draw_target_birdseye_view: create a birdseye view image showing the agent position relative to a navigation goal with colored distance bands
colorize_topdown_map: convert a grayscale top-down map to RGB using indicator values with optional fog of war desaturation masking
colorize_draw_agent_and_fit_to_height: colorize a top-down map, draw agent positions, and resize the output to a specified height for display
